# source => result or diagnostic; a skipped match balances braces but does not evaluate its arms.
0 && match 0 { 0 => { missing }, _ => 7 } => 0
1 || match 0 { 0 => 1, _ => missing } => 1
0 && (match 0 { 0 => 1, _ => 7 }) => 0
0 && match 0 { _ => 1 + * } => 0
0 && match 0 { 0 => 1 => expected closing brace
